    {
      "claim_id": "late_compressed_metadata",
      "necessary": "unknown",
      "necessity_reason": "The packet does not show whether the second image initialization prevents png_read_end from reaching compressed ancillary chunks, or whether those chunks call png_decompress_chunk.",
      "before": {
        "requirement": "Reach supported decompression of compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT when reading a PNG to its end.",
        "applicability": "unknown",
        "harness_status": "unknown",
        "reason": "png_read_info stops at IDAT, while the harness calls png_read_end after png_start_read_image. The intervening initialization and end-reading behavior are not supplied.",

            "end_line": 165,
            "role": "dependency",
            "dependency_reason": "png_read_info returns when it reaches IDAT, leaving later chunks for subsequent reading."
          },
          {
            "unit_id": "u-b53e493521e3901bcbc1",
            "start_line": 266,
            "end_line": 289,
            "role": "dependency",
            "dependency_reason": "The harness calls png_read_update_info, which initializes row reading before its later png_start_read_image call."
          }
        ]
      },
      "after": {
        "requirement": "Reach the same supported decompression of compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT when reading a PNG to its end.",
        "applicability": "unknown",
        "harness_status": "unknown",
        "reason": "The relevant decompression code remains, but the supplied packet does not establish the end-reading call path or the effect of repeated row initialization.",

            "end_line": 289,
            "role": "dependency",

      "comparison_reason": "The old harness uses the same call sequence on both sides. Whether that sequence blocks the same late metadata behavior cannot be decided from the supplied functions.",

        "The complete before and after bodies of png_start_read_image and png_app_error, to determine the effect of the second initialization.",
        "The complete before and after bodies of png_read_end and the compressed ancillary handlers, to establish a path to png_decompress_chunk.",
        "The delegated configuration that determines whether compressed ancillary reading is enabled."
      ],
